description: revu のスキル群を Codex プラグインとして配布するローカルマーケットプレース。

plugins.name: revu
plugins.description: PR review pipeline backed by the revu CLI. Provides revu:pr to generate reviews consumable by revu, revu:edit to safely edit generated review data, revu:read to browse generated reviews, revu:delete to safely delete generated reviews, revu:report to summarize recurring failure patterns across reviews, and revu:create-profile to interactively create repository profiles.
